title: GridConfig layout
description: A GridConfig layout (.grid file). The top level is the base step, which applies at every size. Each other key is a query key: a step with the settings that change from that container size.

step.description: A step: the settings that change when this query key matches. A step writes only what it sets. Keys: 600 (width ≥ 600), ..600, 600..900, x400 (height), 600x400, 16/9 (ratio), landscape, portrait, or a name from breakpoints. A space is AND; a comma is OR. Height, ratio and orientation need container: size.

areas.description: The area map, as a multi-line string. Each line is a row. Spaces separate the cells (nav main main), or, with only capitals and dots, each character is a cell (AAB). . is an empty cell. Each area must be a rectangle. An area that is not in the active map is hidden.

cols.description: The column tracks. Spaces separate the tracks. A bare number is px. SIZE*N repeats a track (1fr*3 → repeat(3, 1fr)). A track with spaces goes in a function: minmax(200px, 1fr). If a step sets areas and not this, the compiler gives equal tracks.

rows.description: The row tracks. Spaces separate the tracks. A bare number is px. SIZE*N repeats a track (1fr*3 → repeat(3, 1fr)). A track with spaces goes in a function: minmax(200px, 1fr). If a step sets areas and not this, the compiler gives equal tracks.

gap.description: Sets --grid-gap on the grid element, which the grid uses as its gap. A bare number is px (8 → 8px). --name is a custom property (var(--name)). A token needs quotes: '{space.2}' → var(--space-2). Terms with an operator between them (--space * 2) become calc(). Anything else goes into the CSS with no change.

padding.description: Sets --grid-padding on the grid element, which the grid uses as its padding. A bare number is px (8 → 8px). --name is a custom property (var(--name)). A token needs quotes: '{space.2}' → var(--space-2). Terms with an operator between them (--space * 2) become calc(). Anything else goes into the CSS with no change.

css.description: Raw declarations for the grid element in this step. The compiler does not change them. Each {, string and comment must be closed.

flow.description: How the direct children of an area are arranged. A map from an area name to a flow. The area becomes a flex container. A flow entry in a step replaces the entry of an earlier step in full.

anyOf.description: [row|column] [main] [cross] [gap <term>] [wrap], or none. main: start center end between around evenly. cross: start center end stretch baseline.
A flow as named keys. A key that is absent gets its default.

main.description: justify-content, on the main axis. Default: start. between → space-between, around → space-around, evenly → space-evenly.

cross.description: align-items, on the cross axis. Default: stretch.

gap.description: The gap between the children. An expression or a list is permitted here. A bare number is px (8 → 8px). --name is a custom property (var(--name)). A token needs quotes: '{space.2}' → var(--space-2). Terms with an operator between them (--space * 2) become calc(). Anything else goes into the CSS with no change.

query.description: A query. Terms: 600 (width ≥ 600), ..600 (width < 600), 600..900, x400 (height), 600x400, 16/9 (ratio), landscape, portrait. A space is AND. A comma is OR. A minimum is included; a maximum is not.

name.description: The name of the layout: the container name, and a part of the data-grid-layout selector. Optional. The default is the file name, or the folder name for layout.grid, index.grid and grid.grid.

container.description: inline-size (the default) or size. Use size for a box with a fixed height, and for height, ratio and orientation keys. With size, the host must get a definite height from the page.

breakpoints.description: Names for queries. A step key can use a name as a term. A name cannot use another name.
